title: Charles Buhler leaves NASA for propellantless propulsion based on Brown

tellings.quote: Not to mention [music] NASA's top scientist in electrostatics, Charles Beer, [music] literally leaving NASA to start a propellantless gravity-based propulsion system that he says is a derivative of Towns and Brown's [music] work.

plain: In the 2020s, Charles Buhler, whom Michels calls NASA's top scientist in electrostatics (the study of static electric charge), left the space agency to start a company building a gravity-based propulsion system that needs no fuel thrown out the back. According to Michels, Buhler says this system comes from the work of the earlier inventor Thomas Townsend Brown. Michels tells it himself as a sign that Brown's ideas are being taken seriously at the top.
